digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and child process runtime management
propositions: Live apply, Git push, ACLI/delivery, and bridge orchestration paths rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments instead of scoped S2 runtimes, causing potential credential leakage to unrelated sibling processes
Jira Cloud scope has implicit DIG fallbacks in write path, live access-check probe, runtime default, and create-time default that can write under unintended scope
Environment variables and secrets are not properly isolated between child processes; unrelated siblings can access other adapters' secrets and Rebar can mutate global os.environ
Multiple code locations hardcode DIG as default (resolve_jira_settings, access_check.py, runtime.py, project_ensures.py) instead of failing closed when scope is unset
